question: Swachh Toycathon Competition 2022 was launched in India by Ministry of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Housing and Urban Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• **The Swachh Toycathon Competition 2022** was launched in India by the** Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA).**
 
• The competition was launched as part of the** Swachh Amrit Mahotsav, a nationwide campaign to commemorate the 75th anniversary of India's independence.**
 
• The **Swachh Toycathon Competition aimed to promote innovation and circularity in the design and manufacturing of toys, and to encourage the use of recycled materials in toy production.**
 
• The **competition was open to individuals, groups, and start-ups from all over India.**
 
• The winners of the competition were awarded cash prizes and incubation support from** IIT Kanpur.**
